title: Security log integrity violation
description: The hash chain is broken, sequence numbers are missing, the heartbeat stopped for more than 15 minutes, or events no longer match the schema: security events may have been deleted, modified or suppressed.

mitre.name: Disable or Modify Tools: Disable or Modify Cloud Log

false_positives: NEXORA restored from a backup (sequence reset), or the NEXORA scheduler/cron is not configured (heartbeat gap).
tuning: A heartbeat gap without other findings usually means the NEXORA cron stopped; a chain break never has a benign cause.
